info.title: typesearch · News search API
info.description: News search by topic: across an index of news outlets, on a live site, or for articles similar to a given one, judged by a calibrated relevance model. Compatible endpoints for Perplexity (/compat/perplexity), Exa (/compat/exa) and Tako (/compat/tako): see the migration guides at https://typesearch.ai/docs. Pricing, per 1,000 requests: ultra and fast $1.40, normal $2.20, deep $5.60; similar $2.20 ($4.60 in deep mode); live site search $2.40. Contents, per 1,000 pages: $0.20, or $0.40 with a query. Each query in a multi-query request is billed as one search of its mode; cached results and failed requests are free. The same list, machine-readable, is in `x-pricing`.

query.description: One query, or up to 5 judged together.

sources.description: Only these index sources, by domain, such as example.com. GET /v1/sources?domain=… tells you whether a domain is covered.

include_domains.description: Only these domains or paths. A domain includes its subdomains.

sections.description: Only these sections: the section in the feed, or the start of the URL path.

days.description: The last N days; null for the whole index. Defaults to 7 unless dates are given.

published_after.description: Published on or after this date. A bare date is read in Argentina time (UTC−3).

published_before.description: Published on or before this date; a bare date includes that whole day.

mode.description: ultra: headlines only · fast: headlines and standfirsts (these two cost the least, the same) · normal: reads the best matches · deep: more headlines, the topic also in other words (synonyms and acronyms), twice the reading, snippets and the essentials of each article, and the search of the sites that cover the topic when the index falls short.

highlights.description: Very short verbatim excerpts (up to 25 words, never from the first paragraph) from the articles that were read: one per article, two in deep mode. On by default only in deep mode.

dedupe.description: Groups the same story reported by several outlets.

tone.description: Tone toward the query: positive, neutral or negative.

essential.description: The essentials: very short verbatim excerpts across several articles. On by default only in deep mode.

questions.description: Structured output: typed questions (boolean, choice, score) that the model answers for each result.

max_tokens.description: Cap on model tokens. If it is reached, the response comes back with incomplete: true.

temporal.description: auto: a date in the query («today», «yesterday», «tomorrow», «on September 22», «this week») is taken out of the topic, sets the publication window (unless published_after/before are given; days only bounds it) and puts the results from that day first · off: the query is taken literally.

timezone.description: IANA time zone that decides what day «today» is. Defaults to Argentina (America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires).

stream.description: Server-sent events while it searches: step, partial, result.

site.description: The live site to search, such as example.com.

post.summary: Search the index for one topic, or up to five
post.description: When the index has fewer than 3 good matches for a single query, discovery looks for sources beyond it within a time budget (3 s in normal, 8 s in deep; ultra and fast add at most 0.8 s: the open news index and one relevance check, the rest keeps learning in the background): outlets proposed by a topic model and by an open news index, read at the original site with robots.txt respected and judged by the same relevance model; in deep, also the search that those sites declare, with a topic keyword. Discovered results come with `found_in: discovery`; `discovery` says what it did and `incomplete` whether the time ran out. With stream: true, index results arrive first and discovered ones in later partial events. Open news index built from the GDELT Project (gdeltproject.org).

200.description: The result; with stream: true, server-sent events.

schema.description: Server-sent events: step, partial, result or error; `data` is JSON.

402.description: Payment required: `insufficient_credits` (no credit left), `spend_limit_reached` (the key hit its monthly limit) or `budget_too_small`.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457). In English unless the request sends `Accept-Language: es`.

get.summary: Get the index coverage, or check one domain
get.description: The coverage of the index in numbers: how many sources and articles, by country and by language. We don’t publish the list of sources. With `domain`, whether that domain is covered (a `Source`). To find outlets beyond the index, discovery also uses an open news index. Open news index built from the GDELT Project (gdeltproject.org).

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: One domain, such as example.com: whether it is covered.

200.description: The coverage (`Sources`), or one domain (`Source`) with `domain`.
